# Squirrel (鼠鬚管) — macOS-ONLY Rime config. Deployed to ~/Library/Rime.
#
# The counterpart of dotfiles-windows' AppData/Roaming/Rime/weasel.custom.yaml.
# Neither file is shared: app_options is keyed by macOS bundle id here and by
# Windows EXE name there. The portable engine-level config (schema_list, per-
# schema patches) lives in .chezmoitemplates/rime/ and IS shared.
#
# Bundle ids below were read from each app's Info.plist on this machine, not
# guessed. To add one:  osascript -e 'id of app "Foo"'
#
# NOTE: there is deliberately no `global_ascii` here. Squirrel has no such
# option — rime/squirrel#201 and #1054 both attempted it and were closed
# unmerged, and the installed Squirrel binary contains no such key. See
# docs/input_methods/README.md for the full analysis. Windows/Weasel does
# support it, so the two frontends differ here on purpose.
patch:
  # Terminals and editors start in 西文 (ASCII) on focus, so typing commands
  # never needs a manual 中/英 switch first.
  app_options:
    com.apple.Terminal:
      ascii_mode: true
    org.alacritty:
      ascii_mode: true
    com.github.wez.wezterm:
      ascii_mode: true
    dev.warp.Warp-Stable:
      ascii_mode: true
    com.googlecode.iterm2:
      ascii_mode: true
    com.microsoft.VSCode:
      ascii_mode: true
    com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92:   # Cursor
      ascii_mode: true

README.md-345-- **Linux audit framework** (optional, Linux only, `installAuditd=true`): [`auditd`](docs/sysadmin/auditd.md) + baseline rule set (identity / sudoers / sshd_config / privileged-exec watches), plus `audit-*` shell helpers and `tv sessions` / `tv sudo-history` / `tv audit-events` Television channels for the routine "who did what on this server" queries. Full guide: [docs/sysadmin/](docs/sysadmin/README.md); ansible role: [docs/playbooks/auditd.md](docs/playbooks/auditd.md)
README.md-346-- **Homelab hardware monitoring** (optional, Linux/physical only, `installHomelabTools=true`): hardware-monitoring CLIs ([lm-sensors, smartmontools, ipmitool, nvme-cli, storcli](docs/sysadmin/hardware.md)) installed only when the matching hardware is detected, plus the `hw-*` shell helper family (`hw-fans`, `hw-temps`, `hw-raid`, `hw-smart`, `hw-status` …) for the "is this server's hardware healthy?" sweep. Full guide: [docs/sysadmin/hardware.md](docs/sysadmin/hardware.md)
README.md-347-- **Wake-on-LAN** (optional, Linux/physical only, `installWakeOnLan=true`): arm a box's wired NIC to power on remotely from a [magic packet](docs/sysadmin/wake-on-lan.md), persisted across reboots via a `wol@<iface>` systemd unit; send from any machine with the `wake` CLI (`wake <host>`) or `wakeonlan`. Wake-from-full-shutdown also needs a one-time BIOS change (Power On By PCI-E on, ErP off). Full guide: [docs/sysadmin/wake-on-lan.md](docs/sysadmin/wake-on-lan.md)
README.md-348-- **Media / AV tools** (optional, `installMediaTools=true`): [ffmpeg](docs/tools/ffmpeg.md), [ImageMagick](docs/tools/imagemagick.md), [exiftool](docs/tools/exiftool.md), [libvips](docs/tools/libvips.md). Plus three zsh helpers (`compress-video`, `extract-audio`, `to-wav16k`) at [`dot_config/zsh/tools/29_media.zsh`](dot_config/zsh/tools/29_media.zsh). Also satisfies `vhs`'s runtime ffmpeg dep.
README.md-349-- **System audio & media control** (cross-platform): `sys*` shell helpers — `sysvol` / `sysmute` (built-in, always available) and `sysplay` / `sysnow` (with `installMediaControl=true`, which adds `nowplaying-cli`/`switchaudio-osx` on macOS and `playerctl` on Linux). Enables remote one-key mute via `fleet exec --login -- sysmute on`. See [docs/tools/media-control.md](docs/tools/media-control.md).

=== .chezmoitemplates/rime/default.custom.yaml
# Rime — SHARED, PLATFORM-PORTABLE config.
#
# This file is rendered verbatim into the Rime user folder on every platform:
#   Windows (Weasel)   %APPDATA%\Rime\default.custom.yaml
#   macOS   (Squirrel) ~/Library/Rime/default.custom.yaml
#   Linux   (ibus)     ~/.config/ibus/rime/default.custom.yaml
#
# It is kept BYTE-IDENTICAL in both dotfiles repos:
#   daviddwlee84/dotfiles          .chezmoitemplates/rime/default.custom.yaml
#   daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows  .chezmoitemplates/rime/default.custom.yaml
# Edit one, copy it to the other, and `diff` them — that diff IS the drift check.
#
# Only engine-level keys belong here. Frontend style and per-app options are not
# portable (Weasel keys app_options by EXE name, Squirrel by bundle id) and live
# in weasel.custom.yaml / squirrel.custom.yaml instead.
#
# Every schema below ships bundled with both Weasel and Squirrel (plum's
# `:preset` package set — see plum/preset-packages.conf), so nothing is
# downloaded at deploy time.
#
# Rime never rewrites *.custom.yaml: switch state and the last-used schema go to

# Squirrel (鼠鬚管) — macOS-ONLY Rime config. Deployed to ~/Library/Rime.
#
# The counterpart of dotfiles-windows' AppData/Roaming/Rime/weasel.custom.yaml.
# Neither file is shared: app_options is keyed by macOS bundle id here and by
# Windows EXE name there. The portable engine-level config (schema_list, per-
# schema patches) lives in .chezmoitemplates/rime/ and IS shared.
#
# Bundle ids below were read from each app's Info.plist on this machine, not
# guessed. To add one:  osascript -e 'id of app "Foo"'
#
# NOTE: there is deliberately no `global_ascii` here. Squirrel has no such
# option — rime/squirrel#201 and #1054 both attempted it and were closed
# unmerged, and the installed Squirrel binary contains no such key. See
# docs/input_methods/README.md for the full analysis. Windows/Weasel does
# support it, so the two frontends differ here on purpose.
patch:

**兩台 Mac 的注音選字鍵不同，原因是 Squirrel 版本：本機 1.1.2 內建 rime-bopomofo 3.0（⇧1–⇧0 選字），ts_hanru_mac 是 1.0.3 內建 rime-bopomofo 2.4（Shift+A–J 選字）。你想統一成哪一種？**

Options:
- **⇧+數字 (Recommended)** - 新版預設。升級 ts_hanru_mac 後就自動一致；再加 managed bopomofo(_tw).custom.yaml 把它固定下來，以後上游再改也不受影響。
- **Shift+A–J** - 舊版行為。用 bopomofo(_tw).custom.yaml patch alternative_select_keys=ABCDEFGHIJ 並改 labels，兩台都用字母選字。
- **只升級，不加 patch** - 跟著上游預設走，不新增 managed 檔案。

**本機 installInputMethod=false，所以 repo 的 Rime 設定（page_size 9、schema_list、終端機預設英文）根本沒部署到這台（本機選單只有 5 個候選就是這原因）。要在本機打開嗎？**

Options:
- **打開 (Recommended)** - 改 ~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml 的 installInputMethod=true 後 chezmoi apply；兩個輸入法都已安裝，ansible 會跳過安裝只部署設定。
- **維持 false** - 本機繼續不受 chezmoi 管理 Rime 設定。


**Answer:** ⇧+數字 (Recommended), 打開（並且看看本機推薦的config等等是否有納入chezmoi了 以免覆蓋後沒了）". Read the answers carefully — they may request clarification, changes, or that you not proceed — and follow what they actually say.
</details></tool-use>

# Squirrel (Rime): upgrade ts_hanru_mac + sync config across both Macs

## Context

Findings (read-only investigation):

| | Local (Hanrus-MacBook-Pro) | ts_hanru_mac (Mac mini, macOS 27, arm64) |
|---|---|---|
| Squirrel | **1.1.2** (= latest `squirrel-app` cask) | **1.0.3** — outdated |
| librime | 1.16.0 | 1.13.0 |
| Bundled rime-bopomofo | 3.0 → select with **⇧1–⇧0** (key_binder maps `Shift+!@#…` → `KP_1…KP_0`) | 2.4 → `menu/alternative_select_keys: ABCDEFGHIJ` (**Shift+A–J**) |
| `installInputMethod` | **false** → no `*.custom.yaml` deployed | true → all 3 managed files deployed, byte-identical to repo |
| Effective page_size | 5 (upstream default) | 9 (repo `default.custom.yaml`) |
| Installed via | not brew (pkg/Sparkle) | not brew (pkg/Sparkle) |

- The ⇧digit vs ABCD difference is **purely the Squirrel version** (the bundled schema changed), not our config.
- The local menu showing only 5 candidates, and terminals not starting in ASCII, happen because local `installInputMethod=false`.
- Local `~/Library/Rime` holds only `build/`, `*.userdb/`, `installation.yaml` and `user.yaml`. There is **no hand-written `*.custom.yaml`** that enabling chezmoi could overwrite, so nothing gets lost. userdb and user.yaml stay unmanaged on purpose.
- Remote `user.yaml` has `zh_hans: true`: someone toggled 簡體 output at runtime there. That is per-machine state and isn't synced by design. Toggle it back via the Ctrl+` menu if it's unintended.
- Unrelated: the remote chezmoi checkout is `ahead 6, behind 7` with local modifications. I'll leave it alone and just mention it.

User decisions: standardise on **⇧+數字**, and pin it with a managed patch. Enable `installInputMethod` locally.

## Steps

1. **Upgrade Squirrel on ts_hanru_mac 1.0.3 → 1.1.2.** It isn't a brew install, so `brew upgrade` won't see it. Run `brew install --cask --force squirrel-app` over ssh. That adopts it under brew and runs the pkg installer, which needs sudo, so the user may need to run it interactively (`ssh -t`). The fallback is Squirrel's menu → "Check for Updates…" on that Mac. Afterwards, check `installation.yaml` shows `distribution_version: 1.1.2`.
   - The cask is `auto_updates`, so `just upgrade-*` skips it unless greedy. That is expected, so no repo change is needed.
   - Also update the ansible cask name in `dot_ansible/roles/input_method/tasks/main.yml:39` from `squirrel` to `squirrel-app`. The old name only resolves as a rename alias.

2. **Pin ⇧-digit selection with a shared patch** in a new `.chezmoitemplates/rime/bopomofo.custom.yaml`:
   ```yaml
   patch:
     menu/alternative_select_labels: ['⇧1','⇧2','⇧3','⇧4','⇧5','⇧6','⇧7','⇧8','⇧9','⇧0']
     key_binder/bindings/+:        # append; duplicates of 3.0's own rules are harmless
       - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+exclam, send: KP_1 }
       # … through Shift+parenright → KP_0
   ```
   - Render it via `private_Library/Rime/bopomofo.custom.yaml.tmpl` (`{{ template "rime/bopomofo.custom.yaml" . }}`). Add a Linux `~/.config/ibus/rime/` counterpart following the same pattern as the existing two files.
   - `bopomofo_tw` does `__include: bopomofo.schema:/`, which may or may not carry `bopomofo.custom:/patch`. Check `build/bopomofo_tw.schema.yaml` after deploy. If it isn't inherited, add a matching `bopomofo_tw.custom.yaml`.
   - The header comment explains why: rime-bopomofo 2.4 used Shift+A–J and 3.0 uses ⇧digit, so this pins the behaviour.
   - Shared-template rule: the file has to be copied byte-identically to `dotfiles-windows` (not cloned here). I'll mention this in the final report.

3. **Enable locally:** set `installInputMethod = true` in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml:120`. Then `chezmoi diff` (expect only new `~/Library/Rime/*.custom.yaml`) → `chezmoi apply`. The ansible role skips installs because both .app bundles exist.

4. **Redeploy Rime on both Macs:** `"/Library/Input Methods/Squirrel.app/Contents/MacOS/Squirrel" --reload`. Push the repo change, then on ts_hanru_mac run `fleet-apply-file ~/Library/Rime/bopomofo.custom.yaml` or a manual `chezmoi apply`. Its diverged checkout may need a manual pull first.

5. **Docs:** update `docs/input_methods/README.md` (+ `.zh-TW`) with the new managed file, the selection-key note, and the version table. The README option row is unchanged.

## Verification

- Both Macs: `installation.yaml` → `distribution_version: 1.1.2`, `rime_version: 1.16.0`.
- Both: `sed -n '/^menu:/,/^punctuator:/p' ~/Library/Rime/build/bopomofo_tw.schema.yaml` shows ⇧ labels, `page_size: 9`, and no `ABCDEFGHIJ`. Grep `build/bopomofo_tw.schema.yaml` for `Shift+exclam` to confirm the patch was inherited.
- `diff` the remote `~/Library/Rime/*.custom.yaml` against local (via ssh cat): they should be identical.
- Manual check: type ㄧㄡˇ in a text field on each Mac and confirm 9 candidates with ⇧ labels and that Shift+2 picks the 2nd one. In Terminal/Ghostty, focus should start in ASCII. Ghostty isn't in `app_options` yet; add `com.mitchellh.ghostty` if the user wants it.

---
# Input method role - Traditional Chinese input methods
# macOS: McBopomofo + Squirrel (RIME) via Homebrew cask
# Linux: ibus-rime via apt

# =============================================================================
# macOS: McBopomofo
# =============================================================================

- name: Check if McBopomofo is installed (macOS)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /Library/Input Methods/McBopomofo.app
  register: mcbopomofo_check

- name: Install McBopomofo via Homebrew cask (macOS)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
    - not mcbopomofo_check.stat.exists
  community.general.homebrew_cask:
    name: mcbopomofo
    state: present

# =============================================================================
# macOS: Squirrel (RIME)
# =============================================================================

- name: Check if Squirrel (RIME) is installed (macOS)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /Library/Input Methods/Squirrel.app
  register: squirrel_check

- name: Install Squirrel (RIME) via Homebrew cask (macOS)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
    - not squirrel_check.stat.exists
  community.general.homebrew_cask:
    name: squirrel
    state: present
  failed_when: false
  register: squirrel_install_result

- name: Re-check Squirrel after install attempt (macOS)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
    - not squirrel_check.stat.exists
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /Library/Input Methods/Squirrel.app
  register: squirrel_recheck

- name: Warn Squirrel install requires sudo (macOS)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
    - squirrel_recheck.stat is defined
    - not squirrel_recheck.stat.exists
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: >-
      Squirrel cask install needs sudo (pkg installer) and chezmoi/ansible runs non-interactively on macOS.
      Run manually in a terminal: brew install --cask squirrel

# =============================================================================
# Linux: ibus-rime
# =============================================================================

- name: Install ibus-rime (Ubuntu)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: ibus-rime
    state: present
    # Universe package covered by base's best-effort cache refresh; don't re-run
    # apt-get update here (a broken/flaky source would abort the play).
    # See pitfalls/apt-update-fails-base-role-empty-error.md.
    update_cache: false

- The local Mac has no hand-written `*.custom.yaml` (only build/, *.userdb/, installation.yaml, user.yaml), so turning on chezmoi there overwrites nothing. Userdb (learned words) and user.yaml stay unmanaged.
- Turning it on locally *does* change the local schema menu to the repo list: 朙月拼音·简化字, 朙月拼音·語句流 and 筆畫 drop out of the menu. Their schema files stay on disk and can be added back to the shared `schema_list` if wanted.
- **Install method needs no change.** The `squirrel-app` cask just installs the same official `Squirrel-1.1.2.pkg`, and the cask is marked `auto_updates`, so `brew upgrade` skips it anyway. Squirrel updates itself through Sparkle. Moving it under brew would gain nothing.

## Steps

1. **Upgrade ts_hanru_mac to 1.1.2.** On that Mac: Squirrel menu → 檢查更新 (Sparkle). The non-GUI fallback is `ssh -t ts_hanru_mac 'brew install --cask --force squirrel-app'`, which needs a sudo password for the pkg installer. Afterwards `installation.yaml` should show `1.1.2` / `1.16.0`, and Shift+A–J changes to ⇧digit automatically.
2. **Pin ⇧-digit selection** in the new shared `.chezmoitemplates/rime/bopomofo.custom.yaml`:
   ```yaml
   patch:
     menu/alternative_select_labels: ['⇧1','⇧2','⇧3','⇧4','⇧5','⇧6','⇧7','⇧8','⇧9','⇧0']
     key_binder/bindings/+:        # append; duplicates 3.0's own rules harmlessly
       - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+exclam, send: KP_1 }
       # … Shift+at→KP_2 … Shift+parenright→KP_0
   ```
   - Render it through `private_Library/Rime/bopomofo.custom.yaml.tmpl`, plus the Linux `~/.config/ibus/rime/` counterpart if the existing files have one.
   - `bopomofo_tw` does `__include: bopomofo.schema:/`. Check `build/bopomofo_tw.schema.yaml` after deploy, and if the patch isn't inherited, add a matching `bopomofo_tw.custom.yaml`.

3. **Turn on locally:** set `installInputMethod = true` in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml:120`, then `chezmoi diff` (expect only new `~/Library/Rime/*.custom.yaml`), then `chezmoi apply`. Ansible skips installs because both .app bundles exist.

The remote also needs the new file: its checkout is diverged (`ahead 6, behind 7`, uncommitted edits), so do a manual `chezmoi apply ~/Library/Rime/bopomofo.custom.yaml` after pulling, or `fleet-apply-file`. 5. **Small cleanup:** change the cask name in `dot_ansible/roles/input_method/tasks/main.yml:39` and the warning message from `squirrel` to `squirrel-app` (the old name is only a rename alias).
6. **Docs:** in `docs/input_methods/README.md` (+ `.zh-TW`), add the new managed file and a note on selection keys by version, and mention that Squirrel updates through Sparkle (pkg) rather than brew.

## Verification

- Both Macs: `installation.yaml` shows `1.1.2`/`1.16.0`, and `pkgutil --pkg-info im.rime.inputmethod.Squirrel` shows 1.1.2.
- Both: the `build/bopomofo_tw.schema.yaml` menu block has ⇧ labels, `page_size: 9`, no `ABCDEFGHIJ`, and contains `Shift+exclam`. `build/default.yaml` `schema_list` starts with `bopomofo_tw`.

- Manual check: on each Mac, Ctrl+` shows 注音·臺灣正體 first. Typing ㄧㄡˇ gives 9 ⇧-labelled candidates and Shift+2 picks the 2nd. Terminal starts in ASCII.

之所以能共用：Weasel 與 Squirrel 內建的方案集完全相同（都是 plum 的 `:preset`
套件組 — `bopomofo`、`cangjie`、`luna-pinyin`、`terra-pinyin`、`stroke` 等），
所以同一份 `schema_list` 在三個平台解析結果一致，不需要額外下載方案。

各平台的 renderer 只有一行 `{{ template "rime/<檔名>" . }}`：

- macOS（Squirrel）→ `private_Library/Rime/*.yaml.tmpl` → `~/Library/Rime/`
- Linux（ibus-rime）→ `dot_config/ibus/rime/*.yaml.tmpl` → `~/.config/ibus/rime/`
- Windows（Weasel）→ `AppData/Roaming/Rime/*.yaml.tmpl` → `%APPDATA%\Rime\`

**修改流程**：改其中一個 repo 的 `.chezmoitemplates/rime/`，複製到另一個 repo，
再 `diff` 兩份 — 那個 diff 就是 drift 檢查。

### 不可攜：各平台自己一份

| 檔案 | 平台 | 為什麼不能共用 |
|---|---|---|
| `private_Library/Rime/squirrel.custom.yaml` | macOS | `app_options` 以 bundle id 為 key |
| `AppData/Roaming/Rime/weasel.custom.yaml` | Windows | `app_options` 以 EXE 檔名為 key；`style/` 是 Weasel 專屬 |

一個具體差異：Weasel 支援 `global_ascii`（全域共用中／英狀態），Squirrel 不支援 —
`rime/squirrel#201`、`#1054` 都是關閉未合併，本機安裝的 Squirrel 也找不到這個
關鍵字（見上面「已知限制」）。所以 Windows 那份有這個設定、macOS 這份刻意沒有，
這正是兩個檔案必須分開的實際理由。

### 仍然不納管

`build/`、`installation.yaml`、`user.yaml`、`*.userdb/`、`sync/` 全部維持不納管，
理由同前一節。這點現在是結構性保證而不只是慣例：chezmoi 只管理它自己知道的那幾個
`*.custom.yaml`，同目錄下的其他檔案不會被碰到。

已驗證 Rime 不會回寫 `*.custom.yaml` — 切換狀態與最近使用方案是寫進 `user.yaml` 的
`var/option/…` 與 `var/previously_selected_schema`（librime `src/rime/switcher.cc`
的 `Switcher::SetActiveSchema`）。所以這些可以是一般 managed file，不需要像 herdr
那樣用 `modify_` overlay。

### 改完設定要重新部署

- macOS：從輸入法選單選「重新部署」，或
  `/Library/Input Methods/Squirrel.app/Contents/MacOS/Squirrel --reload`
- Linux：`touch ~/.config/ibus/rime/ && ibus restart`
- Windows：`chezmoi apply` 會自動跑 `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`

Unix 這邊刻意維持手動：Squirrel 的 `--reload` 不夠可靠，而 `ibus restart` 會打斷
當前輸入狀態，都不適合塞進 `chezmoi apply`。

### McBopomofo

McBopomofo 的 `*.txt` 詞庫與 plist 仍未納管，維持前一節的備份建議即可。

# Rime — SHARED, PLATFORM-PORTABLE config (see default.custom.yaml header).
#
# Pin 注音's candidate-selection keys to Shift+digit (⇧1…⇧0).
#
# The bundled rime-bopomofo changed this between releases, so two machines on
# different Squirrel/Weasel versions disagreed:
#   rime-bopomofo 2.4 (Squirrel 1.0.x)  menu/alternative_select_keys: ABCDEFGHIJ
#   rime-bopomofo 3.0 (Squirrel 1.1.x)  key_binder Shift+!@#…) → KP_1…KP_0
# Digits themselves are bopomofo keys (大千式 1=ㄅ 2=ㄉ …), so a plain digit can
# never select. This appends 3.0's own bindings — a harmless duplicate there,
# and the ⇧-digit route on older releases (2.4's Shift+A–J keeps working too).
#
# bopomofo_tw does `__include: bopomofo.schema:/`, which pulls in this patch,
# so 注音·臺灣正體 needs no file of its own.
patch:
  menu/alternative_select_labels: ['⇧1', '⇧2', '⇧3', '⇧4', '⇧5', '⇧6', '⇧7', '⇧8', '⇧9', '⇧0']
  key_binder/bindings/+:
    - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+exclam, send: KP_1 }
    - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+at, send: KP_2 }
    - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+numbersign, send: KP_3 }
    - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+dollar, send: KP_4 }
    - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+percent, send: KP_5 }
    - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+asciicircum, send: KP_6 }
    - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+ampersand, send: KP_7 }
    - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+asterisk, send: KP_8 }
    - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+parenleft, send: KP_9 }
    - { when: has_menu, accept: Shift+parenright, send: KP_0 }
EOF

The 1.0.3 on ts_hanru_mac did show an update notice on 9/24, but it was closed. **No need to switch to Homebrew:** brew's `squirrel-app` installs the same package, and since it's marked as self-updating, `brew upgrade` skips it anyway.
- **⇧+number vs ABCD:** this comes from the Squirrel version, not your config. 1.0.3 bundles the older 注音 schema, which uses Shift+A–J; 1.1.2 uses ⇧1–⇧0.

The content is fine: no commits were lost or duplicated, and both conflicts were resolved and tested. Only the shape of the history is off.

**What I should have done:** on ts_hanru_mac, `git pull --rebase` to replay its six commits on top of origin/main, resolve the two conflicts there, and push. This Mac then just pulls. History stays one straight line and origin stays the only sync point. I've saved this as a memory, so future "update this machine to latest" requests will work that way.

**Should we fix it now?** I recommend leaving it as is. `70d616a` is already on origin/main, and ts_hanru_mac has pulled it. Making it linear would mean rewriting history and force-pushing main, then resetting every machine that already pulled. That's riskier than one extra merge commit.
